title: Consultant for Construction Permit Plan Reviews
short_description: Consulting services for construction permit plan reviews for mobile home park projects.
project_scope: Consulting support for construction permit plan reviews for construction and alteration projects, typically new mobile home parks, rebuilt mobile home parks after fire loss, and other large-scale projects such as mobile home park infrastructure updates. Plan sets may exceed 300 pages.
services: Construction permit plan reviews; cost estimating; inspection services; planning/master planning support.
relevance_explanation:
- Primarily permit plan review and consulting services, not structural or design engineering.
- Focus is on mobile home parks and infrastructure updates, which do not match sbp core target sectors.
- No bridge, long-span roof, special structure, stadium, or complex building scope identified.
- Disciplines requested are cost estimating, inspection, and planning/master planning rather than structural design.
- Falls close to excluded consulting/project management-type services.
construction_cost_explanation: No construction cost is stated in the tender notice. fee_explanation: No fee information is provided. This is an RFP/RFQ for consultant review services with a 36-month base period, but no contract value, hourly rates, or estimated workload are stated.
